questions.title: Early Hints (103 Status Code)

questions.realWorldScenario: Your server-side rendered pages take 1-2 seconds to generate. During this time, the browser is idle. Use HTTP 103 Early Hints to send preload hints for critical resources (CSS, JS, fonts) while the page is being generated.

questions.title: Production HTTP Optimization Architecture
questions.question: Design a comprehensive HTTP optimization strategy for a high-traffic e-commerce API handling 50,000 requests/second. Cover compression, caching, connection pooling, protocol selection, and monitoring.
questions.realWorldScenario: Your e-commerce platform handles 50,000 req/sec during peak hours (Black Friday). Current challenges: 1) Response times degrade to 2-5s during peak, 2) Bandwidth costs are $50K/month, 3) Mobile clients on slow networks timeout, 4) CDN hit rate is only 40%, 5) Database is overwhelmed with duplicate queries. Design a comprehensive HTTP optimization strategy covering: protocol selection (HTTP/2, HTTP/3), compression (GZIP, Brotli), caching (ETags, Cache-Control, CDN), connection pooling, async processing, request coalescing, and streaming for large responses. Include monitoring, A/B testing approach, and gradual rollout strategy.
